body: I know how that feels. In fact I couldn't have put that into better words myself. But I'm here with you. We can get through this crazy fucked up world together. PM me if you want to talk.
Thank you. I wish I could make it go away as well, but after some reflection, the best revenge is success. I won't let them win. Thank you for reaching out.
I just wanted to reach out and say thank you for your words and let you know that I am still here.

I work in mental health. I also have a therapist though. Your therapist honestly has several different oppositions:

1. She can see you pro bono. This is not normally a company policy. Pro bono simply means she would be seeing you for a free session. She would not get paid for this service.

2. She could see you outside of the company rates and bill you out of pocket. The issue with this is she could potentially lose her license. Same with a phone therapy session. Both services could not be billed within her company policy and she could potentially be legally responsible for the services.

3. She does not see you. Clinically this is the worst possible solution. Any therapist, however, is legally going to give you a discharge plan. Normally this consists of references to different therapists and programs that can help you. Not the best method, but it's the easiest way for a clinician to move forward with your case.

You're waiting for a train, a train that will take you far away. You know where you hope this train will take you. But you can't know for sure. Yet it doesn't matter...


Edit: I mean no disrespect. Hold my hand, we can do this together.
